title: BIR collections up by 5.63% to P2.81 trillion through October

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) recorded P2.814 trillion in gross revenue collections from January to October 2026, an increase of P149.86 billion or 5.63 percent compared with the same period last year, based on the latest collection report as of Nov. 12, 2026. For October alone, gross collections reached P348.54 billion, up P19.48 billion, or 5.92 percent, from October 2025. Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza said the Bureau is targeting to surpass the P3 trillion collection mark before the end of November while sustaining its year-on-year revenue growth.
